transcript: Who's there? Do you have fun outside? You want to go back out? No, you want to stay in? What did you do out there? You just laid? What else? Do you want me to dry you off? I had to get the snow off you. Yeah, you can't keep it on inside. It'll melt!
metadata_caption: Just a few of our favorite snowy moments while we patiently wait for the snow this year! #dog #talkingdog #alaskanmalamute
